title: asplenium gueinzianum var. subintegrifolium
intro: Asplenium gueinzianum var. subintegrifolium, commonly known as the Mountain spleenwort, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and possess anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium gueinzianum var. subintegrifolium include its ability to act as a vasodilator, reduce blood glucose levels, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
